info.prompt: Neon-veined hands emerge from a void-black altar, cradling a single translucent die that pulses between cyan and magenta like a failing heart, the surrounding bio-mechanical chapel walls throbbing with gold filigree circuits as synaptic bridges collapse one by one in time with a decaying 40Hz sub-bass, the air thick with the scent of ozone and myrrh as holographic confession scrolls burn away at the edges.
